newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit closes easier vs dollar in slow dealings.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit closes easier vs dollar in slow dealings.

text.p: The ringgit limped to an easier local close against the dollar in quiet trading, dealers said.
"The ringgit fell in early trade, but nothing much happened after that," said one local bank dealer.
The strength of the dollar and lack of corporate demand held back the ringgit, they said.

Earlier, expectations of continued ringgit demand from a major telecommunications deal did not materialise. But dealers said sentiment is positive on the ringgit on hopes of a trade surplus for August.
At the 1000 GMT local close, ringgit was at 2.5002/12 per dollar against 2.4993/03 on Friday.
In the money market, interbank rates were slightly firmer in slow dealings, with the one-month rate at 7.15/20 percent from 7.08/15.
